english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a can or metal container, especially when naming its contents.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for a metal can or tin used as a container.

examples.english: This can of soda is mine.
examples.jyutping: nei1 gun3 hei3 seoi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3

examples.english: This tin of dace with black beans has never been opened.
